73K likes, 743 comments - thesiddharthnigam on October 2, 2026: "From taking a holy dip at the Sangam and seeking blessings at the Bade Hanuman Temple in Prayagraj, to returning to where it all began My childhood home...

This journey wasn’t just about travel; it was about tracing my roots. The temple visits throughout were absolutely amazing and deeply moving. By God’s grace, completing my father’s Pind Daan right there in Bodh Gaya during Pitru Paksha with absolute peace and grace felt like a profound divine blessing. 🙏✨

Concluding this soulful journey in Bodh Gaya which was exceptionally clean and wonderfully maintained visiting the majestic Mahabodhi Temple and receiving so much love and respect made it an experience that words simply cannot capture. 💫

Swipe through to experience a piece of my heart across these 20 slides. 👇

 #Sangam #Prayagraj #BodhGaya #Roots #PindDaan".
